name: Drupal Canvas
description: Empowers content creators to build experiences by composing components, with as much freedom as site builders allow, all without needing to write code.

submodules.name: canvas_ai
submodules.purpose: AI features for Drupal Canvas (integrates drupal/ai and ai_agents to assist building/editing components and layouts).

submodules.name: canvas_oauth
submodules.purpose: Provides OAuth2-based authentication for Canvas's external HTTP API (built on simple_oauth).

submodules.name: canvas_personalization
submodules.purpose: Adds personalization/segmentation features so component trees can vary by audience.

submodules.name: canvas_vite
submodules.purpose: Enables Hot Module Replacement (HMR) for Canvas via a Vite dev server for code-component development.

project_description:
Drupal Canvas enables site builders without Drupal experience to easily theme and build their entire website using only their browser, without the need to write code beyond basic JSX and CSS, and content creators are able to compose content on any part of the page without relying on developers. 

 Unlike competing tools, it provides tools for re-use across channels and managing content at a large scale because it leverages Drupal’s strengths (like structured data and fine-grained access controls) to achieve data and design consistency. 

 With Drupal Canvas, content creators are able to use a single CMS to manage content across headless and coupled contexts, and site builders will be able to make large scale design changes like rebranding, and perform large scale content operations like imports, exports, and migrations.

 
 ▶ Watch an introduction to Drupal Canvas 

 Try Drupal Canvas or Read Documentation 

 Drupal Canvas was originally developed under the working name 'Experience Builder'.
